primitives.name: Path Clearance Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: In order not to do so and at the same time make a safe and sure pass, he is obliged to swing up under the line, keeping out of the path of the play.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'d': 'distance in meters', 't': 'time in seconds', 'v': 'velocity in m/s'}
primitives.assumptions: Runner and quarterback follow deterministic paths; clearance is binary (clear or obstructed).
primitives.breakdown_regime: When d(t) < threshold, collision risk occurs.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a collision avoidance vector field in phase space where clearance is a topological invariant.
layer2.telemetry: Distance between quarterback and runner trajectory at critical time t.

primitives.name: Ball Placement Precision
primitives.verbatim_quote: As the runner approaches, the quarterback must be able to place the ball in the runner's body and then withdraw, leaving the runner a free path.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'p_b': 'ball position vector in m', 'p_r': 'runner position vector in m', 't_f': 'time of pass in s'}
primitives.assumptions: Perfect coordination between quarterback and runner; ball placement is instantaneous.

layer2.mapping: Derived from kinematic coupling kernel between quarterback and runner motion vectors.
layer2.telemetry: Euclidean distance between ball and runner at pass execution time.

primitives.name: Play Failure Attribution
primitives.verbatim_quote: When a play has failed, the quarterback should know exactly what caused it to fail.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F': 'failure indicator in {0,1}', 'C_i': 'constraint violation in {0,1} for i-th player', 'T': 'total number of players'}
primitives.assumptions: Failure is a Boolean event; each player contributes independently to constraint violations.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a logical conjunction of individual player constraint failures.
layer2.telemetry: Binary flag indicating presence of any constraint violation.
